title: Policy entity numeric layer drifted from the sealed schema
impact: The committed policy expected 28 numeric-plus-missing inputs while schema v1 emits 26, causing every neural forward pass with entities to fail before any Kaggle qualification or training.
containment: No cloud qualification, training, checkpoint promotion or submission used the defective forward path.
root_cause: Numeric layer widths were handwritten constants instead of being derived from the sealed feature-name tuples.
corrective_action: Derive player, entity, option and global numeric layer widths from their schema constants and strengthen qualification fixtures, serialization and recurrent-gradient checks.
regression_test: The full suite passes 97 tests; the exact committed bundle executes end-to-end and records nonzero gradients for all seven selected components.
